summary.text: This opportunity briefing examines the combination of attention sinks, pruning, and softmax for long-context decoding and efficient key-value cache transfer in transformer models. Existing approaches suffer from rigid pruning heuristics and binary selection schemes that drop necessary context or fail to protect critical tokens. By integrating these techniques, models can use dynamic thresholding or tiered precision to prune uninformative tokens while explicitly preserving attention sinks and high-importance context. Per the DVF axis scores, the Demand score is 3.0 and the Feasibility score is 4.0.
